scope: Fiji medical discovery — Fiji National University College of Medicine, Nursing and Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: FNU's College of Medicine, Nursing and Health Sciences is currently active and offers higher-education programmes; its official site links prospective students to the university prospectus and support/accommodation pages.
FNU's 2026 outreach material identifies the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery as a current aspirational entry route at the College.
FNU's May 2026 College graduation list includes Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery graduates.
Fiji's Higher Education Commission lists Fiji National University as a registered university and explains national qualification accreditation/recording requirements.

holdReasons: No current official MBBS programme page or prospectus with route-specific duration, admissions requirements and fees was established.
University registration is not programme-specific medical recognition; no current independent MBBS recognition/accreditation evidence was established for the necessary badges.
A complete current clinical-placement and international student accommodation/support evidence packet was not completed.
nextAction: Obtain FNU's current MBBS prospectus/programme record and fee schedule, then independently verify programme recognition and complete clinical and student-life evidence before packaging.
